title: Polite Japanese
titleJp: {丁寧|ていねい}な{日本語|にほんご}

canDos.text: Understand polite staff speech at a hotel, a restaurant or on the phone, and reply in everyday です/ます Japanese.
Phone to make or change a booking, asking about what you don't know (what time it starts, whether there are seats).
Text your partner exactly where you are: just about to leave, on the way, or just arrived.
Read a booking confirmation or a hotel notice written in polite Japanese and find the key details.

task.goal: Book a table for an anniversary dinner by phone: find out if there are seats at your time, what the course includes, and whether you can bring a cake.

roles.a: Customer calling to book (card A: dates, number of people, requests)
roles.b: Restaurant staff (card B: free tables, course details, house rules)

capstone.title: An evening to remember
capstone.brief: Arrange a special evening: phone a restaurant to book (one of you plays the staff, in polite Japanese), ask about things you don't know (what time it closes, whether you can bring a cake), then on the night tell each other where you are (just leaving, on the way) and arrive together.
